description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, any signed-in caller): report a share (POST /api/v1/shares/:id/report) with a short reason and, optionally, a public evidence URL; a report never carries a password, cookie or private message. Reports go to the moderation queue with the share's captured evidence and the reporter's subject. The request and answer bodies are added with CON-5's abuse contracts; the capability is registered here so the queue and the grant exist before code.
